record_source: Owner instruction to the Claude Code Cloud session (Stage34) continuing Issue #278 / draft PR #287 at 2c41e8cd93574c356ba375fafba47ba65a480217: whole-arch retention and wire/current qualification
subject: Positive lateral retention of the R33 J-SIG/J-PWR arches that still allows the 15 mm withdrawals, and the remaining electrical and wire evidence

provisional_baseline.R33_rear_face_middle_headers: Provisionally used as the DESIGN-STUDY baseline: A01:J-SIG:middle at (250, 152) and A01:J-PWR:middle at (290, 150) on the A01-middle rear face
provisional_baseline.R33_reservations: RV-ARCH-J-SIG, RV-ARCH-J-PWR and the four RV-ACCESS columns are provisionally reserved for this study
provisional_baseline.owner_informed: Final adoption would require assembly-side (second SMT side on A01-middle) and copper-routing changes

changeable.retention_parts: study geometry for captive guides inside or adjacent to the reserved RV-ARCH / RV-ACCESS volumes

broader_change_proposals.rg34_mount_on_rear_carrier: A post on crossmember:rear:0 that carries the RG34 retention channels. It changes the rear carrier (a fastening interface on the crossmember top face) and is proposed only
broader_change_proposals.rg34_outside_reserved_volumes: RG34 walls stand up to guide_wall_mm + guide_clearance_mm - 0.625 mm outside the RV-ARCH slab half-thickness and the sleeves and block occupy the RV-ACCESS columns above the grip zones; proposed only
broader_change_proposals.carrier_registration_requirement: The jack, middle and rear carriers must register to each other within registration_allowance_mm at the enclosure cleats; the cleats are not designed, so this is a requirement on a future enclosure, proposed only
broader_change_proposals.service_procedure_restriction: With RG34 closed, only one end of a cable may be withdrawn at a time; a both-ends withdrawal needs the channel lid opened. Proposed only

fixed: the R33 middle header positions, faces and orientations (study baseline)
the service order: disconnect K-PWR, then withdraw the core 40 mm
the 15 mm withdrawal basis, the 0.5 mm placement margin and the 0.15 mm K4 threshold
the R12 route radius as the primary 10x OD candidate
approval_required_before_use: any change to a neighbouring (foreign) board, its outline or its parts
scope_excludes: merging, canonical CAD adoption, KiCad regeneration, ERC/DRC claims or fabrication output
ordering, quotes, purchases, uploads or supplier contact
calling a design length a measured or cut length
promoting a calculation to a physical pass
